title: fix(app-shell): a stored list sort or filter on a deleted or unreadable field is dropped when the list opens
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb6KQHAgTkT9HJRZ4Ezx4M8E)_

Fixes #28949

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：列表打开时，用户自己存下的排序和筛选现在也走链接参数已有的字段检查。排序层或筛选条件（任意嵌套层级）指向对象已不声明的字段、或当前用户已不可读的字段，就在打开时丢掉；其余存下的状态照常生效。
- **为什么改**：在 app-crm 实测：存下的排序/筛选指向已不存在的字段时，修复前整张列表显示「This view’s query was rejected」（服务端 400 `INVALID_FIELD` / `INVALID_SORT`）；字段对销售代表隐藏时，服务端对同一查询答 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`。链接里的同类字段早已被丢弃，存下的偏好却原样进查询。
- **风险与回滚**：低。只改一个文件里种子（seed）的取值，没有新键、新选项，也不改存储。打开列表时不回写存储行：被丢的部分仍留在行里，字段读权限恢复后会重新生效；用户下一次改排序或筛选时，那一部分被列表当前状态替换。回滚即回退本 PR。
- **先看**：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewListUrlState.ts`（`acceptStoredFilters` 的嵌套遍历、`acceptStoredSort` 对空排序的处理、`acceptField` 提到分支外）；`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.listUrlState-11860.test.tsx` 新增的 objectstack#28949 组。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.listUrlState-11860.test.tsx`，预期全部通过；新组里「a field the object no longer declares」断言查询只带 `priority` 条件和 `due_date` 排序。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`useObjectViewListUrlState` seeds a list from the URL or, when the URL carries no list state, from the user's stored state (`listPrefs`). The URL seed already passed every sort level and filter condition through `acceptField`: a field the object does not declare, or one this user cannot read once field permissions have loaded, is dropped. The stored seed passed `filters` and `sort` in unchecked.

- `acceptField` moves above the URL/storage branch, unchanged, so both seeds use the one gate.
- `acceptStoredSort` drops a level naming a refused field and keeps the others in order. A stored `sort: []` (the user cleared the sort) is kept; a stored sort whose every level is dropped becomes no sort, so the view's own sort applies. This is the rule the URL's `uf__sort` reader already follows.
- `acceptStoredFilters` walks the stored Filter panel group at any nesting. A condition naming a refused field is dropped; a nested group left with no condition is dropped with it; every other entry is kept exactly as stored, row ids included, because the panel rehydrates them. A group nothing was dropped from is returned as the same object. A group left with no condition is no filter.
- No new key, option, or stored shape. `ListPreferencesProvider.tsx` is not touched; only its exported types are imported.

### What the card asks the PR to state (Target 4)

- **Is the dropped part removed from the stored row?** No. Opening the list does not write the preference row. Measured on app-crm: after the fixed list opened, the `ui.list.crm_account` row still held the stale entries. The address bar's `uf__*` mirror shows the cleaned state. The user's next sort or filter change replaces that part of the row with what the list shows. Keeping it means a field whose read access comes back applies again.
- **While field permissions are still loading:** the same rule as the URL seed and the list's columns. Until `perms.isLoaded`, only the declaration check applies; a field the user cannot read is dropped only once permissions have loaded. The seed is taken once per list identity, so a stored entry on an unreadable field would reach the query if the seed were taken before permissions arrive. On app-crm the permissions had loaded before the seed in 4 of 4 opens as a sales rep. Waiting for `perms.isLoaded` was not added: on a permissions error `isLoaded` stays false, so a wait would hold the list closed.

## Tests

`ObjectView.listUrlState-11860.test.tsx`, beside the URL seed's "a malformed or stale param is dropped" pins, gets a new group `a stored sort or filter naming a stale field is dropped too (objectstack#28949)`. It renders the real page and `ListView` and reads the query at the data source:

- a field the object no longer declares: the stale sort level and condition are gone; the valid sort and condition stored beside them reach the query and the address bar;
- a field this user cannot read, once permissions are loaded: dropped; a readable field is untouched;
- every stored entry stale: no filter, and the view's own declared sort;
- CONTROL: while permissions are still loading, only the declaration check applies, as for a link;
- the helpers directly: nested groups at any depth, ids kept, an untouched group returned as the same object, a cleared sort kept, a fully dropped sort gone.

Ablation (one-time, not kept): with the two stored-seed lines put back to the unchecked values, the first three cases fail (3 failed, 25 passed); the restore read blob equal to `HEAD` with an empty `git diff HEAD`.

## Acceptance notes

- **Premise, reproduced on `examples/app-crm`** (`pnpm dev:crm -- --fresh`, view `all` of `crm_account`):
  - *Missing field, as admin.* The stored row held a sort `ghost_field desc, annual_revenue desc` and a filter `ghost_field = x AND industry = technology`. Seeding a field the object does not declare is what a deleted field leaves behind; no field was deleted at runtime. Unfixed Console: the list query (`sort=-ghost_field,-annual_revenue`, filter on `ghost_field`) answered 400 and the list showed "This view’s query was rejected". Fixed Console: the query carried `sort=-annual_revenue` and filter `industry = technology`, and the list showed 2 records.
  - *Unreadable field, as a non-admin.* A sales rep holding `crm_sales_user`, with `crm_account.industry` set unreadable by a temporary local edit to the example permission set (not committed). As the rep, a filter or sort on `industry` answers 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`, which is the query the unfixed seed sends. Fixed Console: the query carried `sort=-annual_revenue` and filter `name contains c`, and the list showed 2 records, in 4 of 4 opens.
- The card expected "an empty or refused list with no hint". On the missing-field case the refusal panel does carry a hint ("Clearing the filters usually fixes it"). It does not name the stale field or mention "Reset view".
- Screenshots are in the project's `issue-28949` folder: `unfixed-deleted-admin.png`, `fixed-deleted-admin.png`, `fixed-unreadable-rep.png`.
